capabilities.why: The agent's sandbox is ephemeral by design, but persistence lets us verify that the durable workspace survives a stop/resume cycle. This is tested by writing a unique marker, stopping and resuming the guest, and confirming the marker survives.

Network policy enforcement at cloud creation time controls whether a guest can reach external hosts. The test creates two guests with open and off modes and verifies the off guest cannot reach github.com while the open guest can reach it.
